{{Quote|Thanks for the help. You're welcome to any of the salvage in the shuttle.|Shariss Kartur|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Shariss Kartur''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. She was good friends with [[Risha Drayen]] and [[Sumalee]], and the three women were called "the Triple Threat" during their extravagant young years. Eventually, the three parted ways: Risha went into organized crime, Sumalee joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and Shariss became an [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. During the [[Galactic War]] in [[3642 BBY]], Shariss was investigating the activities of the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], when she got cornered by a group of [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and had to hide herself in an old [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with no way to escape. She managed to send a call for help to Sumalee, who in turn redirected it to Risha, now traveling in the company of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]]. The two blasted through the Voidwolf's forces, and after a warm reunion, Voidhound smuggled the entire shuttle with Shariss still inside offworld, declaring its content to be Imperial salvage.
